description: Violates E1 (verification-contract.md §5.1, §5.4): a declared check's evidence is a textual claim ('the framework wiring is correct') instead of the evidence declaration. A claim is not evidence — declaring a property is not proving it; evidence is the re-checkable output of a verification operation. The evidence declaration shape requires the recheckable / embeddedOrRecorded / recorded affirmations; a claim-like evidence object is rejected by additionalProperties and the required affirmations.

checks.description: Shared resources are wired at the declared lifecycle point.
